description: This file defines the ChangeQueueActor class, which is an Akka actor responsible for collecting changes from ThingUpdaters, caching them, and providing a stream source of cached change snapshots for downstream processing. It includes methods for enqueuing changes, dumping the cache, and creating an Akka Streams Source that periodically emits snapshots of the current cache state.

classes.name: ChangeQueueActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that manages a cache of Metadata objects representing changes from ThingUpdaters, provides a streaming source of cache snapshots, and handles control messages such as dump requests.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns the Props needed to instantiate a ChangeQueueActor.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior for the actor, including processing Metadata instances and dump commands.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a Metadata change to the internal cache.

methods.name: createSource
methods.description: Creates an Akka Streams Source that emits snapshots of the current cache at specified intervals.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Handles dump command by sending current cache to the sender and clearing the cache.

methods.name: askSelf
methods.description: Returns a function that creates a Source which asks the actor for its current cache, handling the result asynchronously.
